jobs.excerpt: Overview At MasTec Communications Group we build for the future.
jobs.description:
Overview At MasTec Communications Group we build for the future. Yours and ours. As a Project Manager, you will develop new skills, work in a safety-minded environment, and join us in expanding technology for a better community. Join the MasTec family and help us provide the highest level of quality service to our customers and communities while maintaining our commitment to safety! Responsibilities The Project Manager assumes a leadership role and provides guidance to project staff in the development and analysis of complex schedules on large and design-build projects. Experienced and fully competent in the profession, this individual works independently, and acts as a resource for colleagues. In addition, you will: Lead and promote the MasTec safety culture on site, ensure site safety standards are met or exceeded, and lead the development of Site Safety Specific Procedures Facilitate the creation and implementation of the Project Quality Plan (PQP), including quality assurance (QA) requirements, and lead the QA program Create and maintain project schedules (plans) and update all stakeholders weekly Work cooperatively with leadership on business partner selection, procurement, and negotiations Own and communicate the change management process Lead the setup of large project systems and procedures, including the chart of accounts, cost accounting system, and project directory; Lead management of budget for design consultants Manage and lead internal and external project teams to ensure on-budget and on-schedule delivery Report and communicate to the external customer(s) and internal management each day Build processes and teams required to deliver all project requirements Coordinate with the Project Construction Lead for timing, execution, and closeout of individual projects Lead weekly meetings with the client and project team Work with Construction Management and direct them on the overall tasks that need to be completed Track completion, closeout process, and ensure accurate invoicing of each project once complete Approve timesheets and daily logs Ensure the crew has the correct equipment needed for the project Perform other duties as required and/or assigned Qualifications About You: Must have 2+ years of Generator experience or 2+ years of HVAC maintenance experience, to be considered 2+ years of Project Management experience is required Strong Excel skill set, including VLOOKUPs and pivot table creation, is required (And be able to demonstrate it during the hiring process) Safety is a part of your day-to-day You have a track record of completing work with a high level of quality You have a knack for figuring out hard problems and enjoy a hands-on approach to your work You are looking for long-term projects You enjoy getting your hands dirty with your team Possess a High School Diploma or equivalent You have 3 years of construction project experience You have advanced experience with Microsoft Word, and PowerPoint Intermediate experience in schedule management Able to work in a fast-paced environment handling multiple tasks Possess good written and verbal communication skills You have precise hand-eye coordination Clarity of vision at 20 feet or more and 20 inches or less, with the ability to judge distance and space relationships Able to identify and distinguish colors Able to read blueprints accurately Able to communicate progress, highlight issues, and provide recommendations to senior leadership Possess safety training and knowledge of OSHA requirements Ability to commute to work remotely Telecom construction PM or CM experience is preferred Smartsheet proficiency is preferred Compensation of $80,000-$95,000 annually, depending on the experience. Hard work pays off. See what you’ll get for your effort: Financial Security 401(k) with company match Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Life insurance Short-term and Long-term disability Red Wing Boot Voucher Health and Wellness Medical, dental, and vision insurance Dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Work/Life Balance Paid time off Paid holidays Family and medical leave Paid sick time We meet your commitment with competitive pay and benefits. If this sounds like you, let’s talk. Build your career with MasTec! MasTec, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Company's policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. jobs.title: Stage- Ingénieur -  Recherche et analyse des principaux drivers du poids des ins
jobs.excerpt: Soyez acteur de la solution avec Technip Energies et rejoignez-nous pour une carrière unique.
jobs.description:
Soyez acteur de la solution avec Technip Energies et rejoignez-nous pour une carrière unique. Vous contribuerez à développer des solutions de pointe pour résoudre les problèmes énergétiques auxquels notre monde est confronté.

Technip Energies est une entreprise de technologies et d’ingénierie de premier plan. Leader dans le GNL, l’hydrogène, l’éthylène, la chimie durable et la gestion du CO2, nous contribuons au développement de marchés stratégiques tels que l'énergie, les dérivés énergétiques, la décarbonation et la circularité. Nos segments d’activité complémentaires, Technologies, Produits et Services (TPS) et Livraison de Projet, transforment les innovations en réalité industrielle à grande échelle.

Animés par des valeurs de collaboration et d’excellence dans l’exécution, plus de 17 000 collaborateurs dans 34 pays s'engagent pour allier prospérité et durabilité en faveur d’un monde conçu pour durer.

Missions proposées :

Recherche et analyse des principaux drivers du poids des installations offshore/ modulaire /éolienne

Dans l’ingénierie de l’énergie, principalement off-shore mais aussi modulaire et éolien en mer, le suivi du poids et du centre de gravité sont cruciaux, que ce soit pour l’installation, le transport, la stabilité ou la capacité en place.

Il est indispensable dès les études conceptuelles de pouvoir estimer le poids final, même à partir de données préliminaires, et de suivre l’évolution de ce poids tout au long des études jusqu’à la mise en place de l’installation et sa livraison finale.

L’analyse des projets passés permet d’établir des méthodes d’estimation.

Au sein du service ‘’Management du poids et des quantités’’, vous serez en charge, après une prise de connaissance de l’entreprise, du service, des projets et de nos méthodologies, de rechercher, d’étudier et d’analyser les principaux drivers du poids de modules venant de différents types d’installations off-shore/modulaire/éolienne conçues, construites et installées par Technip Energies par le passé.

Vous devrez identifier statistiquement quels paramètres expliquent le mieux le poids final : volume de module, surface de chaque niveau, poids des équipements, nombre d'équipements, densité de tuyauterie, type de procédé, nombre de niveaux, etc.

L’objectif du stage est d’améliorer nos méthodes d’estimation et de développer des outils de calcul dérivant des analyses des projets antérieurs.

Lors de ce stage, vous serez accompagné(e) par un(e) tuteur/tutrice pour répondre à vos différentes questions. Ce stage sera pour vous, l’occasion de monter en compétences, connaissances.

Profil recherché:

Nous serions heureux de vous rencontrer et d’échanger sur votre adéquation à ce poste. Pour réussir cette mission, vous devrez remplir les conditions suivantes :

Ecole d’Ingénieur ou équivalent. Vous recherchez votre stage de fin d’études.

Autonome, proactif(ve), dynamique, vous avez un bon relationnel.

Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais (rapports à analyser en anglais).

Bonne maitrise du pack office (excel, VBA, power BI etc…)

Vous cherchez à réaliser votre stage dans un environnement international et dynamique, à prendre part à des projets d'envergure et à relever des défis techniques et organisationnels ?

Envoyez-nous votre candidature!

Votre carrière chez nous :

Travailler chez Technip Energies est une aventure passionnante, remplie de projets novateurs et de collaborations actives. Entouré(e) de personnes diverses aux nombreux talents, vous vous sentirez accueilli(e), respecté(e) et impliqué(e). Vous évoluerez dans un environnement sûr et bienveillant où vous pourrez proposer de nouvelles idées, réinventer l'avenir et conduire le changement. Au fur et à mesure de l'évolution de votre carrière, vous bénéficierez des possibilités d'apprentissage offertes par T.EN University, telles que le programme « Future Ready », et du soutien de votre manager, par exemple à l'occasion de l'entretien de mi-année, qui favorisent votre épanouissement et développement continus.

Prochaines étapes :

A réception de votre candidature, nos recruteurs évalueront vos compétences, votre expérience et votre aptitude à vous intégrer au sein de nos équipes en fonction des besoins du poste. Nous vous demandons un peu de patience pendant que l’équipe traite le volume de demandes dans les meilleurs délais ! Vous pourrez suivre son avancement via votre compte personnel à partir du profil que vous avez créé lors de votre candidature.

Retrouvez nos actualités en consultant le site et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, et YouTube.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Contracts Manager (Procurement) Location: Remote - US Salary Range: $120,300 - $180,500, plus bonus eligible Who we are: Lynx delivers modular, open standards–based software that transforms how high-assurance, mission-critical edge systems are built, deployed, and maintained.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Contracts Manager (Procurement)

Location: Remote - US

Salary Range: $120,300 - $180,500, plus bonus eligible

Who we are: Lynx delivers modular, open standards–based software that transforms how high-assurance, mission-critical edge systems are built, deployed, and maintained. Our secure edge computing solutions enable innovation and operational excellence in the world’s most demanding environments, from aerospace and defense to commercial and industrial systems. We partner across industries including automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure to deliver tailored solutions aligned with each customer’s mission and operational requirements. Our key products and services are:

  • MOSA.ic: LYNX MOSA.ic™ is a modular software framework and architecture purpose-built for mission-critical edge computing. Based on the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA), it provides a flexible foundation for building secure, scalable, and certifiable edge systems.
  • LYNX MOSA.ic.AI: LYNX MOSA.ic.AI is a unified CPU and GPU software platform that enables deterministic, certifiable deployment of AI and advanced workloads in mission-critical edge systems. It brings control, performance, and lifecycle governance together, allowing AI to operate predictably within safety-critical environments without compromising certification or system integrity.
  • CoreSuite 2.0: CoreSuite 2.0 is Lynx’s safety-critical GPU for graphics enablement framework designed for mission-critical edge computing systems. It provides hardware-accelerated graphics, visualization, and video processing capabilities that can be certified for high-assurance systems.
  • Services: Lynx Services is Lynx’s professional services organization that helps customers design, integrate, certify, deploy, and maintain safety- and security-critical systems. It supports industries like aerospace, defense, automotive, and industrial computing through consulting, engineering, integration, and lifecycle support, reducing development risk and accelerating certification in standards-driven, mission-critical environment.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced, business-minded Procurement and Contracts Manager to own procurement and inbound contracting for a growing technology company delivering software, SaaS, and professional services, primarily in the aerospace and defense industry. This role supports the full vendor lifecycle—from selection and onboarding through negotiation, renewal, and ongoing management—for the vendors, suppliers, and service providers Lynx relies on.

The Procurement and Contracts Manager will manage the inbound vendor lifecycle—from intake and sourcing support through vendor evaluation, negotiation, execution, administration, renewal, and closeout. This role will work closely with Finance, IT, Engineering, Operations, and executive leadership, and will report to the Director of Legal Operations and act as the primary liaison between vendors and the legal team, helping the company select the right vendors and secure favorable terms while appropriately managing legal and commercial risk.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a fast-paced technology environment, can run a competitive sourcing process and negotiate directly with sophisticated vendors and their legal and sales teams, and knows how to distinguish issues that require escalation from those that can be resolved using established company playbooks, pre-approved fallback positions, and sound business judgment.

What Success Looks Like

Within this role, success means becoming a trusted partner to both the Legal team and the business. You will help the company select the right vendors, bring them on board efficiently, secure favorable pricing and terms, improve visibility into spend, upcoming renewals, and contractual commitments, and ensure that material risks receive the right level of review.

You will balance speed, commercial practicality, and risk management—finding workable solutions rather than simply identifying problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end procurement and contracting process for inbound vendor, supplier, and service-provider relationships, from intake request through execution and renewal.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define requirements and assist with vendor selection, including market research, requests for information and proposals (RFIs/RFPs), vendor demos, and side-by-side evaluations of capabilities, pricing, and risk.
  • Support vendor due diligence and onboarding, including security, financial, and compliance reviews, in coordination with IT, Security, and Finance.
  • Prepare, review, negotiate, and administer vendor agreements, starting from company standard templates, including:
    • SaaS and software license agreements
    • Master Services Agreements (MSAs) and Statements of Work (SOWs)
    • Professional services and consulting agreements
    • Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)
    • Hardware, equipment, and other procurement agreements
    • Subcontractor, reseller, and teaming agreements
    • Amendments, renewals, and order forms
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for contract negotiations with vendors and their legal, sales, and procurement teams.
  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, multi-year commitments, and renewal terms (including price-increase caps, auto-renewal provisions, and notice windows) in partnership with Finance and budget owners.
  • Review proposed vendor terms against company standards and flag legal, commercial, operational, financial, security, and compliance risks.
  • Negotiate key provisions (such as intellectual property, licensing, warranties, indemnification, limitation of liability, confidentiality, data protection, insurance, termination rights, and service levels) by advancing the company's standard terms and pre-approved fallback positions per the contracting playbook, and escalating to Legal when a vendor pushes back beyond those positions.
  • Support purchase requisition and purchase order processes and help ensure purchases align with budgets, approval thresholds, and company policy, in coordination with Finance.
  • Own the renewal process: track upcoming renewals and notice deadlines, engage business owners early, and drive renegotiation, consolidation, or non-renewal decisions.
  • Monitor vendor performance against contractual commitments and service levels, and lead vendor business reviews and issue resolution as needed.
  • Track and analyze vendor spend to identify savings opportunities, consolidate vendors, and avoid redundant tools and services.
  • Coordinate with Finance, IT, Security, Engineering, Operations, and other internal stakeholders when negotiating agreements, and work with Legal to ensure applicable security requirements and flow-down terms are reflected in vendor and subcontractor contracts.
  • Escalate significant or non-standard legal issues to the Director of Legal Operations as appropriate.
  • Manage executed agreements and key contractual obligations, including renewal dates, notice periods, pricing and volume commitments, reporting requirements, and other milestones.
  • Use LinkSquares as the contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform to manage intake, repository, renewal tracking, and reporting, following established contracting processes.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate contract review, redlining, summarization, obligation tracking, and vendor research and comparison, applying human judgment to validate outputs and protect confidential information.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline procurement and contracting workflows, reduce cycle times, and improve consistency across agreements.
  • Assist with due diligence, audits, corporate transactions, compliance initiatives, and other Legal department projects as needed.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 3+ years of procurement, strategic sourcing, contracts management, commercial contracting, or comparable experience, preferably within a software, SaaS, technology, or professional services company.
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendor selection and sourcing processes, including RFPs, vendor evaluations, and competitive bids.
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating vendor or commercial agreements, including working from standard terms and preset fallback positions.
  • Working familiarity with common technology contract terms, such as software licensing, SaaS, confidentiality, data protection, warranties, indemnities, and limitations of liability. Legal expertise is not required; Legal is available to support more complex issues.
  • Experience negotiating directly with vendors, including pricing, renewal, and termination terms.
  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle management platforms, preferably LinkSquares.
  • Comfort using AI tools to improve contracting efficiency, with sound judgment about accuracy, confidentiality, and when human review is required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple negotiations, renewal deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to determine when an issue should be escalated to counsel or senior management.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving processes and priorities.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with software/SaaS and professional services procurement, particularly in the aerospace and defense industry.
  • Experience with government contracting and the FAR/DFARS, including subcontract and supplier flow-down requirements.
  • Experience with spend analysis, vendor management, or procurement and spend management tools.
  • Familiarity with a variety of contracting tools, including CLM, electronic signature, and AI-assisted contract review platforms.
  • Familiarity with CRM and business systems such as Salesforce.

Sound Exciting? Get in touch today! We have very robust benefits including:

  • Low-cost Medical / Dental / Vision coverage options
  • 401K with generous employer match
  • Responsible Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays
  • Remote work opportunities based on role
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career growth and professional development opportunities

Lynx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, color, disability, national origin, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity and/or expression, or other characteristics or status protected by law.
